text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide runs her best race<n>ever... but it still
isn't enough to win<n>the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If the venue for the race hadn't been<n>changed,
Biwa Hayahide could've<n>maximized the results of
her equation<n>and maybe even won...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide wants to be the<n>greatest of her
generation and<n>eventually defeat Narita Brian, so
she<n>isn't satisfied with her current<n>performance.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That's why our next goal is the<n>Takarazuka Kinen,
where only the<n>best are chosen to race. We begin
working hard, so Biwa Hayahide can<n>improve even
more.
